text: 敵ネットワーク機関ユニットであるアダム及びイブの撃破が確認された
translation: The destruction of the enemy network core units Adam and Eve has been confirmed.
grammar: されたis passive form indicating the action was confirmed

text: 現在敵の指揮系統は一時的な混乱状態にある / この後期を逃さず人類軍は機械生命体に対し総攻撃をかけることが決定された
translation: Currently, the enemy's command structure is in a state of temporary chaos. Without missing this opportunity, the human forces have decided to launch a total offensive against the machine lifeforms.
grammar: 〜ずforms a negative meaning with verb (逃さず= without missing)

text: 無論我々ヨルハ部隊も例外ではない
translation: Of course, we YoRHa units are no exception.
grammar: 〜ではない is negative copula (is not)

text: 思い返せ!故郷を奪われた苦しみを!
translation: Remember! The suffering of having our homeland stolen from us!
grammar: Imperative form せ! for command; passive られた indicates the homeland was taken from them

text: 我々は諦めはしない / 海を空を大地を
translation: We will not give up. The seas, the skies, the land...
grammar: 〜はしない emphasizes negative (absolutely won't)

text: おぞましき機械生命体に奪われた地球を取り戻す
translation: We will reclaim the Earth that was stolen by those abominable machine lifeforms.
grammar: き is classical attributive form of adjective modifying noun

text: 本作戦の成功をもって / 今ここでこの戦争を終わらせるのだ
translation: With the success of this operation, we will end this war here and now!
grammar: のだ adds emphasis and determination to the statement

text: 人類に栄光あれ
translation: Glory to mankind!
grammar: あれ is archaic imperative meaning 'may there be'

text: 人類に栄光あれ
translation: Glory to mankind!

text: サーバー管理担当3S / サーバー管理担当3S
translation: Server administrator 3S. Server administrator 3S.

text: 容量管理のため / 速やかにサーバー管理室に戻ってください / 以上
translation: For capacity management purposes, please return to the server room promptly. That is all.
grammar: 〜のため = for the purpose of, because of

text: 司令部より各ヨルハ部隊員へ / 地上に降下したら事前プログラムに従い作戦を自動遂行してください
translation: From command to all YoRHa unit members: Once you descend to the surface, please follow the pre-programmed instructions and execute the operation automatically.
grammar: 〜たら = when, after (conditional)

text: 2Bに真実を告げることができないまま
translation: Unable to tell 2B the truth...
grammar: 〜ないまま = while remaining unable to, without doing

text: 最後の大規模進行作戦が開始された / だけど僕はまだ知らなかった / この戦いの結末と僕たちの運命を
translation: The final large-scale offensive operation began. But I still didn't know... The outcome of this battle and our fate.

text: 以上が命令です / 理解できましたか / えーっと
translation: Those are your orders. Do you understand? Umm...

text: 僕たちスキャナー部隊は総攻撃に備え / 敵の防空システムをハッキングで麻痺させる / その通りです
translation: We Scanner units will prepare for the total offensive by paralyzing the enemy's air defense system through hacking. That's correct.

text: よくできました / なんか子供扱いされてる?
translation: Well done. Am I being treated like a child?
grammar: 〜されてる is casual form of passive されている

text: 気のせいです
translation: It's your imagination.

text: 防空システムを受信している機械生命体は電波状況の良い高所にいるはずです / ハッキング対象の機械生命体について大雑把な予測位置をマップに転送しました
translation: The machine lifeforms receiving the air defense system should be in high places with good radio conditions. I've transferred the approximate predicted positions of the hacking targets to your map.
grammar: 〜はず = should be, expected to be

text: 了解
translation: Understood.

text: 対象はくれぐれも破壊しないでください
translation: Please make absolutely sure not to destroy the targets.
grammar: 〜ないでください = please don't do

text: 破壊してもしばらくすると代わりの個体が現れてキリがありません / はいはいそんなことしませんよ
translation: Even if you destroy them, replacement units will appear after a while and there'll be no end to it. Yes, yes, I won't do that.
grammar: 〜ても = even if

text: 対象は電波状況の良い高いところにいると推察されます
translation: The targets are presumed to be in high places with good radio conditions.
grammar: 〜と推察される = it is presumed that

text: ビルの屋上などを調べてみてください / 了解
translation: Please try checking building rooftops and such. Understood.
grammar: 〜てみる = to try doing

text: ハッキングに成功したみたいですね
translation: It seems you succeeded in hacking.
grammar: 〜みたい = seems like, appears to be

text: 偉いですね / やっぱり子供扱いされてる / 次もよろしくお願いします
translation: Good job. I'm definitely being treated like a child. Please continue for the next one too.

text: はーい
translation: Okay!

text: ДИНАМИЧНАЯ МУЗЫКА
translation: Dynamic music (Russian text)

text: 防衛システム 稼働率低下を確認 / もう少しだね
translation: Confirmed decrease in defense system operation rate. Just a little more.

text: 順調なようですね / 今回の作戦では他のスキャナー部隊員も総動員されています / 私たちも遅れを取らないようにしなければ / はーい遅れを取らないようにしまーす
translation: Things seem to be going smoothly. In this operation, other Scanner unit members are also being fully mobilized. We mustn't fall behind either. Okay, I'll make sure not to fall behind!
grammar: 〜ないようにする = to make sure not to do

text: 何? / 戦闘中はなるべく当該エリアから離れてください / それじゃ支援できませんけど / あなたのようなスキャナーモデルは戦闘向きではありません
translation: What? During combat, please stay away from the relevant area as much as possible. But then I can't provide support. Scanner models like you are not suited for combat.

text: あれ、心配してくれてるんですか? / いえ、戦場にいても足手まといなだけですので
translation: Huh? Are you worried about me? No, it's just that you'd only be a burden on the battlefield.
grammar: 〜てくれる = to do something for someone (with kindness)

text: ひどすぎる
translation: That's too harsh.
grammar: 〜すぎる = too much

text: 報告、目標の大型機械生命体に直接配金するのは不可能
translation: Report: Direct hacking of the target large machine lifeform is impossible.

text: 特殊なプロテクトを検知 / 機械生命体以外からのアクセスを拒否している模様
translation: Special protection detected. It appears to be rejecting access from anything other than machine lifeforms.

text: 推奨、まず小型の敵を乗っ取り / その敵を利用して大型の敵をハッキング / 多段でハッキングすればいいのか
translation: Recommendation: First hijack a small enemy, then use that enemy to hack the large enemy. So I should hack in multiple stages?
grammar: 〜ばいい = should do, it's good if

text: 11Sより9Sで、聞こえますか? / 聞こえます / こちらの担当分作業は全て終了
translation: 11S to 9S, can you hear me? I can hear you. All work in my assigned area is complete.

text: そっちはどう? / こっちも、あと一つかな / 了解、あと、バンカーに戻ったらデータ同期をしておいて
translation: How about you? Me too, maybe one more left. Understood. Also, when you get back to the Bunker, make sure to do data synchronization.
grammar: 〜ておいて = make sure to do in advance

text: あ、忘れてた / 君の戦闘データが未能だから
translation: Ah, I forgot. Because your combat data is still pending...

text: スキャナーモデル全体がアップデートできないんです / 了解 この作戦が終了したら対応する / 頼みましたよ
translation: The entire Scanner model can't update. Understood. I'll handle it when this operation is over. I'm counting on you.

text: これで分担は全部かな / 推奨戦闘状況が発火する前に
translation: I guess that's all my assigned work. Recommendation: Before the combat situation ignites...

text: 2ビート合流 / 分かってる
translation: Rendezvous with 2B. I know.

text: えーっと / 2ビートの合流地点を地図にマーク
translation: Let's see... Marking 2B's rendezvous point on the map.

text: と
translation: Done.

text: 敵防衛システム完全に沈黙 / やればできるじゃないですか / いつもできてるよ
translation: Enemy defense system completely silenced. You can do it when you try, can't you? I can always do it.
grammar: やればできる = you can do it if you try

text: 素晴らしい成果なのでご褒美を用意しました / 私の部屋に置いておくので後で取りに来てください
translation: Since it's such excellent results, I've prepared a reward. I'll leave it in my room, so please come get it later.
grammar: 〜ておく = to do something in advance

text: ご褒美?
translation: A reward?

text: 始まった
translation: It's begun.

text: 2Bさんの作戦開始地点は廃魚都市の南西にあります
translation: 2B's operation start point is southwest of the flooded city.

vocabulary.reading: さくせんかいしちてん

text: 飛行ユニットで向かい現地で9Sさんと合流してください
translation: Please head there with your flight unit and rendezvous with 9S on site.

text: 了解 / 先日のイブ戦で破損した武器も修復して搭載しておきました / 到着時にはすでに全体の作戦が始まっていますので気をつけてくださいね
translation: Understood. I've also repaired and equipped the weapons that were damaged in the recent battle with Eve. The overall operation will have already started by the time you arrive, so please be careful.

text: ありがとう
translation: Thank you.

text: 月面人類回路 / 地上で噴泉しているアンドロイドショベル
translation: Lunar human circuit. To all androids fighting on the surface...

text: 我らが誇る精鋭ヨラハブ隊
translation: Our proud elite YoRHa forces...

text: 敵ネットワークユニット / アナーおよびイブを敵にした
translation: Have defeated the enemy network units Adam and Eve.

text: この勝利は地球奪還に向けての大きな一歩だ
translation: This victory is a major step toward reclaiming Earth.

text: 我々月面の人類も喜びの声に生きている
translation: We humans on the moon are also filled with voices of joy.

text: 今後の更なる諸君が健闘に期待
translation: We look forward to your continued excellent efforts going forward.

text: 人類抵抗をあえ
translation: Glory to mankind!

text: 状況は? / 作戦は開始 / 先行部隊はすでに交戦中 / 僕たちの役割は
translation: What's the situation? The operation has begun. The advance units are already engaged in combat. Our role is...

text: 先行部隊の状況に合わせて援護する / 遊撃部隊
translation: To provide support according to the advance unit's situation. A guerrilla unit.

text: 先行部隊が交戦している場所を / マップに転送しました
translation: I've transferred the locations where the advance units are engaged to your map.

text: 援護に向かいましょう / 了解
translation: Let's head to provide support. Understood.

text: こちらセブンB / 先行攻撃部隊デルタ隊長 / 攻戦中の機械生命体が暴れていて
translation: This is 7B, advance assault unit Delta captain. The machine lifeforms we're fighting are going berserk and...

text: 手をつけられない / こちらセブンB / 遊撃部隊 / 今からそちらの縁が乗った / 了解 感謝する
translation: We can't handle them. This is 7B, guerrilla unit. We're heading to support you now. Understood. Grateful.

text: 助かった / 僕たちは次の部隊の援護に向かいます
translation: You saved us. We're heading to support the next unit.

vocabulary.meaning: to be saved, to be helped

text: 私たちもそちらに同行し援護しよう / 了解
translation: We'll accompany you and provide support. Understood.

text: こちら攻撃部隊オメガの8B / 担当空気をステアートした / 捕獲
translation: This is 8B of assault unit Omega. We've secured our assigned area. Captured.

text: こちら3B / チータ部隊隊長だ / 機械生命体どもがどんどん増えていて / 手に負えない
translation: This is 3B, Theta unit captain. The machine lifeforms keep multiplying. We can't handle them.

text: ありがとう私たちも同行しよう / 視界が悪いですね
translation: Thank you. We'll go with you too. The visibility is poor.

text: 報告 / 適正機械生命体の反応が通常よりも増加 / イブのネットワークが破壊されたのに
translation: Report: Enemy machine lifeform responses are increasing beyond normal levels. Even though Eve's network was destroyed...
grammar: 〜のに = even though, despite

text: どうして奴ら暴走してるんでしょう / 私たちは戦うだけ
translation: Why are they running wild? We just fight.

text: こちら4B 天候攻撃部隊アルファ 隊長 敵の攻撃に手を焼いている / こちら2B 遊撃部隊 今からそちらの援護に行か
translation: This is 4B, assault unit Alpha captain. We're having trouble with enemy attacks. This is 2B, guerrilla unit. We're heading to support you now.

text: 了解 感謝する
translation: Understood. Grateful.

text: 助かった / 僕たちは次の部隊の援護に向かいます / 我々もそちらに同行し援護しよう
translation: You saved us. We're heading to support the next unit. We'll accompany you and provide support too.

text: スービーさん、新たな敵の出現を確認しました / 部隊オメガが強撃を受け苦戦中です
translation: 2B, we've confirmed the appearance of new enemies. Unit Omega is under heavy attack and struggling.

text: 援護に向かってもらえますか / 了解 / 思ったより苦戦していますね / 急がないと
translation: Could you head to support them? Understood. They're struggling more than expected. We need to hurry.
grammar: 〜てもらえますか = could you do (for me)?

text: こちら入撃部隊の2B / これより部隊オメガを援護する
translation: This is 2B of the guerrilla unit. We will now support unit Omega.
grammar: これより = from now on, hereafter

text: 連合感謝 / このままゲが勝てる / ないえず、さらに増援がコモンの周辺を警戒して
translation: Extremely grateful. We can win at this rate. However, more reinforcements are coming. Be alert in the surrounding area.

text: 了解
translation: Understood.

text: 何?この音
translation: What? This sound...

text: サビー!
大丈夫? / 油断した
translation: Are you okay? I let my guard down.

text: 至近距離からのEMP攻撃が再起動しないと
translation: EMP attack from close range... I need to reboot.
grammar: 〜ないと = must do, need to do

text: 援護する
translation: I'll cover you.

text: 四角め
translation: Damn machines...
grammar: 〜め is derogatory suffix

text: 何がどうなってるんだ / 何が
translation: What's going on? What...
grammar: 〜んだ = explanatory, emphatic ending

text: 僕が守る
translation: I'll protect you.

text: くそ / 次から次へと / 早く倒して 2Bを助けないと
translation: Damn! One after another... I need to defeat them quickly and help 2B.

text: 大丈夫? / ちょうべい!
translation: Are you okay? Just barely!

text: この息を入れそう
translation: No time to rest...

text: ツービー!
ウィルス汚染 / さっきのEMP攻撃がトリガー
translation: Virus contamination. That EMP attack was the trigger.

text: なんとか
translation: Somehow...

text: デュビー、大丈夫?
translation: 2B, are you okay?

text: なんだ?
translation: What is this?

text: 汚染されて / 乗っ取られてる
translation: She's been contaminated. She's being hijacked.

text: そんな / 攻撃機能が動かない
translation: No way... My attack functions won't work.

text: ヨルハ部隊の識別信号だ / 僕が2Bをハッキングして識別回路を焼き切る
translation: It's a YoRHa unit identification signal. I'll hack 2B and burn out her identification circuit.

text: お願い
translation: Please.

text: コットン!司令部に通信!状況確認!
translation: Pod! Contact command! Check the situation!

vocabulary.reading: じょうきょうかくにん

text: 不確認!機械生命体による妨害電波を開始 / くそ!
translation: Unable to confirm! Jamming waves from machine lifeforms detected. Damn!

text: ドゥビー! / 妨害電波を出している個体をマークした! / わかった! / 目標地点の情報を入手
translation: 2B! I've marked the unit emitting the jamming waves! Got it! Target location information acquired.

text: マップにマーク
translation: Marked on map.

text: おやすみなさい
translation: Good night.

text: あのデカいのから / 妨害電波が出ているようです
translation: It seems the jamming waves are coming from that big one.
grammar: 〜ようです = it seems, it appears

text: ジャミングは解除されたはず / 司令部に通信 状況報告と救援要請
translation: The jamming should be cleared. Contact command. Report situation and request rescue.

vocabulary.reading: じょうきょうほうこく

text: ポッド / 通信ロストは司令部に接続できず / くそ まだジャミングが / 通信環境は良好
translation: Pod. Communication lost, unable to connect to command. Damn, the jamming is still... Communication environment is good.

text: 通信ロストは接続認証の失敗によるもの
translation: Communication loss is due to connection authentication failure.

text: 現在司令部の通信機能は完全に注目 / バンカーは一体何があるの?
translation: Currently command's communication function is completely shut down. What on earth is happening at the Bunker?

text: ダメだ、キリがない
translation: No good, there's no end to them.

text: 考えがある / バンカーには非常用のバックドアがあるから
translation: I have an idea. The Bunker has an emergency backdoor, so...

text: そこから僕と2Bのパーソナルログデータを全部アップロードして
translation: From there, I'll upload all of mine and 2B's personal log data, and then...

text: その後ここをブラックボックス反応で吹き飛ばす
translation: After that, blow this place away with a black box reaction.

text: 分かった / データアップロード / 30%完了 50%完了 70%超えた / 9S まだ / もう少し 92%
translation: Got it. Data upload: 30% complete, 50% complete, passed 70%. 9S, not yet? Just a bit more, 92%.

text: 2B ブラックボックスを
translation: 2B, the black box...

text: ログデータのアップロード完了
translation: Log data upload complete.

text: 不要
translation: Unnecessary.

text: 2B、司令部に報告を
translation: 2B, report to command...

text: これは…
translation: This is...

text: 司令官
translation: Commander.

text: 一体何をしてるんだ? / 地上のヨルハ部隊がウイルスによって乗っ取られたんです
translation: What on earth are you doing? The YoRHa units on the surface have been hijacked by a virus.

text: 僕たちは暴走したヨルハ部隊をブラックボックス反応で
translation: We used a black box reaction on the rampaging YoRHa units...

text: ウイルス?何を言ってるんだ / 地上からはそんな報告上がってないぞ
translation: Virus? What are you talking about? We haven't received any such reports from the surface.

vocabulary.meaning: to come in, to be submitted

text: あれは偽装です / 現在バンカーの通信は封鎖されていて
translation: That's a fake. Currently, the Bunker's communications are blocked...

text: そもそも命令もなく戦場からなぜ戻った
translation: To begin with, why did you return from the battlefield without orders?

vocabulary.meaning: to begin with, in the first place

text: だからヨルハ部隊が暴走して
translation: That's because the YoRHa units went on a rampage...

text: 汚染されているのはお前たちじゃないのか
translation: Aren't you the ones who are contaminated?
grammar: 〜じゃないのか = aren't you the one who

text: 違うんです
translation: That's not true.

vocabulary.meaning: to be different, to be wrong

grammar: 〜んです = explanatory, emphatic

text: 2B、9S、貴様たちをウイルソーセンの疑いで拘束する
translation: 2B, 9S. I'm detaining you both on suspicion of virus contamination.

text: 待ってください / うっ / うっ / うっ / うっ
translation: Please wait! Ugh! Ugh! Ugh! Ugh!

text: うっ
translation: Ugh!

text: うっ / おせん
translation: Ugh! Contamination...

text: 司令
translation: Commander...

text: それは… / 私たちが… / 大生命体 / ネットワークとミスタに通じて… / 話しかけて…
translation: That is... We... Machine lifeforms... Through the network and mystery... Speaking to us...

text: そんな…そんなことが… / ずいぶん楽しんでもらったけど…
translation: That can't be... Such a thing... You've enjoyed yourselves quite a bit, but...
grammar: 〜てもらう = to have someone do something (for you)

text: もう…心の基地は終わりに… / さあ… / アホッ!アホッ!アホッ!
translation: Now... Your heart's base is coming to an end... Come now... Ahh! Ahh! Ahh!

text: 開いたよ!トゥビー! / 緊急放送、現在バンガーライフィングコールが戦略の状態になりました / 全余裕のバクター員は速やかにバンガーで返っておいてください
translation: It's open! 2B! Emergency broadcast: The Bunker life support is currently in a critical state. All YoRHa members please return to the Bunker immediately.

text: 繰り返します、現在バンガーライフィングコールが戦略の状態になりました / いっ!人類に栄光が…
translation: Repeating: The Bunker life support is currently in a critical state. Glory to man-- kind...

text: あれっ! / より北海… / 全員はっきり…
translation: What?! YoRHa... Everyone clearly...

text: 意識が… / トゥビー! / 油断しないで!
translation: My consciousness... 2B! Don't let your guard down!

text: 司令カカカ… / ご無影です!
translation: Comman... der... It's no use!

text: あああああああああ!
translation: Ahhhhhhh!

text: 司令官、この基地はもうダメです / 一旦退避しましょう / どうしてお前たち二人は汚染されてないんだ / 分かりません
translation: Commander, this base is finished. Let's evacuate for now. Why aren't you two contaminated? I don't know.

text: いえ、おそらく僕がデータ同期を保留していたからです
translation: Actually, it's probably because I was holding off on data synchronization.

text: 以前、バンカーのサーバーデータにノイズがあったので / それが気になって
translation: Previously, there was noise in the Bunker's server data, so I was concerned about it.

text: そうか / アクセスユニットは汚染されています
translation: I see. The access units are contaminated.

text: 格納庫に行って飛行ユニットを奪いましょう
translation: Let's go to the hangar and take a flight unit.

text: 司令官、格納庫から飛行ユニットで脱出します
translation: Commander, we'll escape from the hangar using a flight unit.

text: 司令官、早く
translation: Commander, hurry!

text: 私は行けない
translation: I can't go.

text: 司令官 / 私もサーバーとデータ同期をしていたからな
translation: Commander... I was also doing data synchronization with the server.

translation: But then 9S can... There's no time for that.

translation: You two are the last of the YoRHa units. You have a duty to survive. Commander... Besides, I'm the commander of this base.

text: せめて最後まで上官らしく 居させてくれ
translation: At least let me remain a proper superior officer until the end.
grammar: 〜らしく = in a manner befitting, like a

translation: Transfer of this unit's control authority to 2B complete. Control of 9S's vehicle acquired.

translation: Course automatically set. Placed on escape route from combat airspace.

text: ちょっと待って / 何これ / ダメだよ
translation: Wait a moment. What is this? No, don't!

text: ステルス機能解除 / ヨルハ機体2B / ステルス機能解除

translation: Warning: Machine...

translation: Multiple enemy responses confirmed.

translation: Warning.

translation: Abnormality detected.

translation: I must not spread the contamination to other androids. Pod, find a location with few android responses.
grammar: 〜ないようにしないと = must make sure not to

text: 検索、報告、商業施設の廃屋付近が該当
translation: Searching. Report: Near the abandoned commercial facility matches.

translation: Warning: If the virus is not removed, serious damage to YoRHa unit 2B. I know...
grammar: 〜なければ = if not, unless

text: 警告、ウイルス汚染度21%に上昇
translation: Warning: Virus contamination level risen to 21%.

text: 汚染の除去と…再起動… / 報告。ウイルスは事故のアルゴリズムを高速で改変、進化しており、除去が困難。
translation: Removal of contamination and... reboot... Report: The virus is rapidly modifying its own algorithms and evolving. Removal is difficult.

text: 月面人類回避。地上が風船している。
translation: Lunar humanity council. The surface is in turmoil.

text: 今日は諸君だ。きっぽん。
translation: Today, everyone. Good work.

vocabulary.meaning: good work, thanks for your efforts

text: この月面の人類回避だ。 / 警告。ウイルス温泉、57%に聴取。FFCS回避。異常を検知。
translation: This is the lunar humanity council. Warning: Virus contamination risen to 57%. FCS circuit: Abnormality detected.

text: 에이...

translation: I guess this is as far as I can go...

translation: These are my memories.

text: みんなを未来をお願いするね
translation: I leave everyone... the future... to you.

vocabulary.reading: ありがとうございました

text: ボックス信号は途絶 死亡を確認
translation: Black box signal has ceased. Death confirmed.

text: 状況を共有する / ヨルハ機体9s は本日 破損部分の復元修復が完了
translation: Sharing status. YoRHa unit 9S has completed restoration and repair of damaged parts today.

text: 再起動可能状態にある / ヨルハ機体 a 2も再起動予定
translation: Ready for reboot. YoRHa unit A2 is also scheduled for reboot.

text: 提案 ライトの点灯 / 確認、A2および9S機体の安全の確保
translation: Proposal: Light activation. Confirmed. Ensuring safety of A2 and 9S units.

text: 問題ない / ならば残りの課題は一つ
translation: No problem. Then there is one remaining task.

text: 我々はヨルハ支援システム / A2および9Sの機体が稼働するなら / 随行支援する義務が存在する
translation: We are the YoRHa support system. If A2 and 9S's units are operational, we have a duty to accompany and support them.
grammar: 〜するなら = if (something) does

text: 同意 / A2および9Sの位置を表示
translation: Agreed. Displaying locations of A2 and 9S.
